messages:
Tom: quick sync — proposal for a lightweight "credit-rebalance" operator to handshake between Dedicated operator and the autoscaler. aim: reallocate spare burst credits across pools without global pauses.
Priya: curious — how different from the existing reservation-credit reconciler?
Tom: rebalancer does not change tenant quotas. it only moves ephemeral burst credits between pools under strict invariants. cheaper/faster than moving reservations.
Mei: invariants?
Tom: 1) never violate tenant committed capacity. 2) maintain headroom floor per pool (configurable). 3) cannot reduce another tenant's active burst below its current inflight demand.
Jorge: sounds race-prone during churn. what's the handshake?
Tom: operator exposes a small intent API: POST /v1/rebalance-intent {from_pool, to_pool, credits, reason, idempotency_key}. autoscaler watches intents and applies if safe. both sides must ack, then operator finalizes.
Priya: mock flow pls — short snippet ok.
Tom: sure — pseudo-yaml:
```yaml
# intent example
intent:
  id: reb-20260301-01
  from: pool-g4-12
  to: pool-g4-18
  credits: 12
  min_headroom: 2
  ttl_s: 120
```
Mei: TTL is good. but what if apply fails mid-way? partial move?
Tom: two-phase: reserve on target, drain a matching credit token from source (logical decrement), commit. failure -> rollback by releasing reserved tokens on target; if commit window expired, autoscaler will garbage-collect and emit alert.
Jorge: who tracks ledger? central DB or CRD status?
Tom: CRD status for intent with event stream in controller; authoritative ledger in control-plane DB for cross-cluster consistency. controller reconciles to DB and reports status.
Priya: audit & billing implications? must not double-bill credits.
Tom: ledger has single-writer commit. we stamp intents with commit_tx_id; billing reads ledger. no double-spend.
SRE-Oncall: telemetry we need: intent latency, success rate, rollbacks, time-to-commit, number of blocked intents due to headroom checks. also alert when rollback rate > 2% over 10m.
Mei: testing matrix: unit tests for invariants, e2e with synthetic churn, chaos test where node pool is lost mid-rebalance.
Jorge: about fairness — prefer proportional rebalance vs greedy filling. suggestion: scoring: score = available_headroom * pool_weight - recent_failures_penalty.
Tom: agree. add tenant affinity check so we don't move credits away from pools with hot-cached KV for that tenant.
Priya: rollout plan?
Tom: phased: 1) dry-run mode (intents created but not enacted; metrics only) 2) canary on non-prod pools 3) limited rollouts by tenant tag (internal first) 4) global enable. each phase gated by automated quality checks.
SRE-Oncall: add automatic revert if commit latency spikes or eviction rates rise.
Mei: config surface for ops: per-pool min_headroom, global max_rebalance_per_min, per-tenant opt-out.
Jorge: API auth? allow operator service account only + mTLS between autoscaler/operator + intent HMAC.
Tom: noted. also plan for backpressure: if operator sees > N inflight intents to a pool, it should slow down new intents for that pool.
Priya: can we simulate with current devtools? need harness for headroom/time-series.
Tom: yes — use the synthetic load generator we use for prewarm tests. add a rebalance mode that injects intents.
Mei: we should write an RFC-style follow-up doc with sequence diagrams and failure modes.
Tom: will draft. target for draft RFC by next Wednesday.
Jorge: quick nit — name: "credit-rebalance" vs "burst-relay"? prefer something explicit.
Priya: "credit-rebalance" fine.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: none.
Tom: action items: Tom -> draft RFC + seq diagrams; Mei -> test matrix + chaos plan; Priya -> telemetry metrics and alerts; Jorge -> security auth + HMAC spec; SRE-Oncall -> rollback thresholds.
Priya: thanks. ping if you want pair on metrics. :white_check_mark:
Tom: thanks everyone. will post RFC link when ready. :rocket:
